paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 7.12, representing a 21.09% change from the prior close and a 12.84% change over a window of 22 sessions. There have been 11 new news articles about the company in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include Fermi securing TensorWave as a $6.5B project tenant for its data center campus Project Matador, as reported by Bisnow, and construction being underway at the campus, as reported by The Lufkin Daily News. Other news sources, such as Stocktwits and Seeking Alpha, have also mentioned the company in relation to market trends and stock movements.

There have been 24 total filings, including 1 Form 4 filing and 15 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include an 8-K form disclosing the appointment of new officers, an 8-K/A form disclosing the resignation of director Miles Everson, and an 8-K form disclosing the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2031.
